purpose: Replace a permissive model-name grammar with exact provider-documented snapshot identities.

sources.identity_scope: Documented named snapshots, full-date snapshots, and historical compact-date snapshots; mutable alias literals in this file are excluded.
sources.verification: Official model pages were fetched and their snapshot tables inspected; the exact IDs are also present in the SDK source at the recorded release commit.

currency_policy: Identity recognition does not fail for an older generation, deprecated status, or age. Currency is maintenance rather than a merge gate. Historical exact snapshots remain accepted; availability and capability are separate claims.
limits: No SDK installation, model invocation, capability comparison, current candidate screen, default selection or FINAL admission. Unknown provider identities remain unverified; this record makes no claim that a similarly shaped name is a snapshot.
